svg.title: RFQ List approval gate
svg.desc: 1. Engineering submits an RFQ only if they are its person in charge, the BOQ has at least one item and the tender has a KTD. 2. Only a KTD on the tender team may decide; a revision request needs a note. 3. If the BOQ changed after the KTD opened the review, the decision is refused until the KTD confirms the latest content. 4. Approval in one transaction sets the RFQ approved, releases the BOQ and moves the procurement to stage 2. 5. Sending to vendors checks the approval again on the server and refuses an unapproved RFQ.
